analysis: STX fell 14.4%, 10.0 points more than the market, amid a broader crash in chip stocks that appears largely shared with its memory and storage peers, which fell a median of 17.1%. Headlines point to a tech sector sell-off, with coverage mentioning Nvidia entering bear territory, Micron sinking 17%, and chip stocks facing a sharp pullback; one item specifically highlights a lawmaker urging "a pause on advanced AI development" alongside STX's decline. The company's typical earnings reaction shows moves averaging around 11.1 percentage points beyond what the market explains, and while it has beaten estimates in its last eight reports, one of those beats was followed by a negative abnormal move; the next report is scheduled for January 26, 2027, 82 days from now.
